provenance.encodes: Bluebook R. 12.9 (ABA Model Code of Judicial Conduct) (21st ed.)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open Bluebook R. 12.9 (ethics codes) and check the `Model Code of Jud. Conduct r. 2.11 (Am. Bar Ass'n 2020)` form.

positive.text: See Model Code of Jud. Conduct r. 2.11(A) (Am. Bar Ass'n 2020).
Recusal is addressed by Model Code of Judicial Conduct Rule 2.11 in most states.
Compare Model Code of Judicial Conduct Canon 3 with Model Code of Jud. Conduct R. 1.2.

negative: The Model Code of Judicial Conduct was revised in 2007.
The Model Code of Conduct for staff has 3 parts.
Canon 3 of the Model Code applies.

note: Canons (1-4) and rules (`2.11`) share the authority key namespace; `Canon 2` and `r. 2` would collide, but the 2007 Code numbers rules with a decimal.
